name: Nexgram Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年公司提出多项企业议案，包括拟议多元化（Proposed Diversification）、债务结算、私下配售及发行Warrants E等，但相关额外上市申请已于8月撤回，公司表示将重新评估整体资本结构与资金需求。业务板块方面，公告未披露具体板块的扩张、缩减或合约信息。
overview_en: In 2026, the Company proposed multiple corporate exercises, including a Proposed Diversification, debt settlement, private placement and bonus issue of Warrants E, but the additional listing application was withdrawn in August and the Company said it will reassess the proposals in light of the Group's overall capital structure and funding requirements. No specific segment expansion, reduction or contract details were disclosed in the announcements.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 今年提出多项企业议案，包括拟议多元化，但额外上市申请已撤回，公司将重新评估议案。
segments.note_en: The Company proposed multiple corporate exercises in 2026, including a Proposed Diversification, but the additional listing application was withdrawn and the proposals will be reassessed.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 公司于2026年8月19日撤回议案的额外上市申请，并将重新评估议案。
actions.text_en: The Company withdrew the additional listing application for the Proposals on 19 August 2026 and will reassess the Proposals.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 公司于2026年4月10日向Bursa Securities提交议案的额外上市申请。
actions.text_en: The Company submitted the additional listing application for the Proposals to Bursa Securities on 10 April 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 公司拟修订议案结构，包括拟议多元化等，详情载于附件第1节。
actions.text_en: The Company intends to revise the structure of the Proposals, including the Proposed Diversification, with details set out in Section 1 of the attachment.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 公司终止Malacca Securities作为议案的顾问，并委任TA Securities Holdings Berhad为替代顾问。
actions.text_en: The Company terminated Malacca Securities as adviser for the Proposals and appointed TA Securities Holdings Berhad as replacement adviser.

model_changes.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
model_changes.text: 议案中包含拟议多元化（Proposed Diversification），具体内容载于公告附件第1节。
model_changes.text_en: The Proposals include a Proposed Diversification, with details set out in Section 1 of the announcement attachment.
